motionPass.principle: Three physically distinct archetypes driven by the same underlying cycleValue x amplitude already exposed by the pure model — no new clock, no second engine.
motionPass.treadmillA: large alternating contralateral arm/leg amplitude, shoulder/pelvis torsion, pronounced vertical bob
motionPass.bikeB: largest leg amplitude (pedaling), near-still arms (gripping handlebars), slight vertical knee-lift simulating the pedal's circular path
motionPass.rowerC: whole-body fore-aft seat slide (root group Z translation), large torso lean, arm pull, leg extension/retraction
motionPass.convergenceMechanism: all three archetypes share the same cycleValue frequency/phase-lock targets during cadence-lock, so very different gestures land on the same beat automatically once cadence locks — the 'three sports, one rhythm' loufoquerie effect, with no second motion engine

secondaryLifeVisibility.fans: enlarged/repositioned; different speeds pre-cadence, explicit convergenceBlend-driven convergence during cadence-lock, synchronized through the full signature window, slight desync recreated in aftermath/residue
secondaryLifeVisibility.towelConveyor: track and towels enlarged, speed also driven by convergenceBlend (slower/irregular pre-cadence, steady after) — continues during signature
secondaryLifeVisibility.counterDispenser: enlarged, repositioned for road visibility; freezes exactly at the start of aftermath-return while fans/conveyor keep moving
secondaryLifeVisibility.selfFoundBug: dispenser freeze originally referenced EUX_GAINENT_PHASES[5] (a raw numeric index), which actually points to reference-inversion (138.800s) rather than aftermath-return (152.730s) — would have frozen the dispenser at the start of the signature window instead of its aftermath. Found and fixed during V3 authorship itself, before any browser testing, by replacing the raw index with a safe id-based lookup: EUX_GAINENT_PHASES.find(p => p.id === "aftermath-return"). tsc/lint re-run and PASS after the fix.

consoleConvergence.preConvergence: each archetype has its own base rate/level (e.g. treadmill 74, bike 86, rower 23) and its own time offset, convergenceBlend < 0.98
consoleConvergence.postConvergence: once convergenceBlend >= 0.98 (measurement/deviation/correction/signature) all three consoles snap to the same shared rate/level and the same TEMPS/DIST — three different exercises suddenly producing identical output, B never individually named

screenGrammar.function: resolveEuxGainentScreenState(absoluteTimeSeconds, phaseId) — pure, additive, co-located with resolveEuxGainentDominantText
screenGrammar.progression: credible varying sport data pre-cadence (TEMPS/DIST./CAD./SÉRIE/GAIN, ~1/s) -> near-plausible bureaucratic fragments during cadence-lock/measurement (SÉRIE, TOLÉRANCE, RESTE) -> first explicit semantic anomaly (RESTE, never explained) -> PERTE --/DESTINATION -- during rendement/signature peak, where secondary lines briefly clear (+/-0.6s window around the analytical peak) leaving only OBJECTIF DÉPLACÉ alone -> hypocritically-normal aftermath with a residual micro-anomaly (RESTE 01) -> SÉRIE TERMINÉE / RESTE 01 in residue
screenGrammar.dominantWordRule: unchanged and unique — one dominant message maximum, secondary fragments never form a second signature phrase
screenGrammar.performanceDiscipline: one combined CanvasTexture (headline + grid + fragments + grime + alignment marks + refresh artifacts) per distinct state, built once and cached — never per text line, never per frame

correctionAndSignatureContrast.correctionMarkerIntensity: rising during deviation (0.35->0.9) then falling during correction-revelation (1->0.15), replacing V2's simple binary threshold with a readable notice/correct/release arc
correctionAndSignatureContrast.signaturePoses: larger V3 motion amplitudes make the pure model's existing freeze values (FREEZE_CYCLE_VALUE, unchanged) read as markedly more recognizable effort postures (e.g. C at 0.42 now reads as pronounced rower flexion) without any pure-model value changing
correctionAndSignatureContrast.machinesVsHumans: stations moving parts, fans, conveyor and consoles all continue visibly while bodies freeze — the frozen-humans/living-machines contrast now rests on much larger amplitudes on both sides
